description: Packaging recipes executed by tools-pec-packager.py. Every option can be overridden with --set KEY=VALUE. Defaults here are the single source of truth for the CLI and the knowledge file.

single-bundle.title: Single-bundle compressor
single-bundle.description: Compress an approved input set into one archive with a clear root layout and a completion manifest.

separate-zip.title: Separate zip per group
separate-zip.description: Create one archive per top-level folder, extension, or size class according to reusable grouping rules.
separate-zip.produces: one archive per group + group manifest

source-release.title: Source release packager
source-release.description: Deterministic source archive with generated files and secrets excluded, licenses kept, plus a round-trip check.
source-release.produces: release archive + manifest + round-trip verification note

version.help: release label used in the archive name

round_trip.help: extract and re-hash the result before publishing

include.help: optional list of glob patterns to include

project-handoff.title: Project handoff packager
project-handoff.description: Clean project bundle containing the required files plus generated HANDOFF.md instructions.

project.help: project name used in the archive name

owner.help: person or team receiving the handoff

evidence.title: Evidence collection packager
evidence.description: Read-only, hash-verified collection with source paths, timestamps, and a chain-of-custody record.
evidence.produces: evidence archive or directory with CUSTODY.json + manifest

archive.help: wrap the collection in a stored ZIP

dataset.title: Dataset delivery packager
dataset.description: Partition a dataset into documented volumes with per-volume manifests and reconstruction instructions.

volume_size.help: target bytes per volume (0 = single volume)

media.title: Media delivery packager
media.description: Group masters, proxies, captions, artwork and metadata by content type without recompression.

deliverable.help: deliverable label used in archive names

archive.help: also build one archive of the media tree

update-patch.title: Update patch packager
update-patch.description: Bundle only changed and added files between two trees, plus rollback information and verification data.

redacted.title: Redacted sharing packager
redacted.description: Exclude sensitive paths, record omissions in OMITTED.md, and publish an auditable manifest.
redacted.produces: shared tree or ZIP + OMITTED.md + manifest

label.help: label used in the archive name

compliance-evidence.title: Compliance evidence packager
compliance-evidence.description: Bundle manifests, checksums, scan output and policy decisions for review without shipping content.

evidence_files.help: files or directories to include as evidence

reviewer.help: reviewer name recorded in the summary

retention-labels.title: Retention policy packager
retention-labels.description: Emit retention and classification labels for a file set without altering the data.

legal_hold.help: mark every file as under legal hold
